item.title: Rav Shneur Kotler’s Letter to the Editor of Dos Yiddishe Vort
item.description: Rav Kotler reflects on the dramatic changes that took place in the quarter-century since the founding of Dos Yiddishe Vort. But the most striking element is not institutional growth per se; it is the profound shift in the self-perception of Torah Jewry. item.title: From Up or Down – Beshalach
item.description: There are different streams in the Torah world today regarding the Beit HaMikdash. The common denominator between them all is that they all want the third Beit HaMikdash to be rebuilt. The only question is how and when. The post From Up or Down – Beshalach appeared first on The Jewish Press - JewishPress.com.

item.title: Q & A: Halacha & the Oral Law (Part II)
item.description: Question: The Written Law is there plain to see as it’s found in the five Books of Moses. However, from whence does the Oral Law come? I’m not asking as one who doubts its veracity – rather, I would simply like to know and not just follow blindly. Mark Grosz Via E-mail The post Q & A: Halacha & the Oral Law (Part II) appeared first on The Jewish Press - JewishPress.com.

item.title: Persuaded – Chapter XXXVIII
item.description: He was a total fair-weather friend! When my husband began to have business problems, Yerucham didn’t come forward to help. I tried to ask him for help—I did it behind my husband’s back, because I didn’t want Benjy to be embarrassed—but he never responded.
